user.title: TAGO Bus Location
user.description: Enter the general service key from data.go.kr. You must apply for both 'TAGO bus location' and 'TAGO bus route' APIs. Either the Decoding or Encoding key works.

city.title: City and route
city.description: Choose a city and enter the route number.

route.title: Select route {route_no}
route.description: Found {count} route(s) numbered {route_no}. Select the ones to show. If each direction is registered separately, select both.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid service key. New keys can take 1-2 hours to activate, and both the bus route and bus location APIs must be approved.

init.title: Polling
init.description:
Shorter intervals use more of your daily quota. Polling slows to every 5 minutes automatically while no bus is running.

You can pick one favorite stop per route here, or tap a stop on the map card. Arrival times need the 'TAGO bus arrival' API; without it, stops remaining are computed from bus positions. {stops_note}

data.road_geometry: Draw route lines along real roads

data_description.road_geometry: Sends stop coordinates to the public OSRM routing server (OpenStreetMap). Only queried when a route shape changes; results are cached.
data_description.favorites: Loop routes list the same stop name once per direction, so check the direction label.

error.one_favorite_per_route: Pick at most one favorite stop per route.
